_why: A set scope's normal form (frontend/src/lib/setScope.ts normalizeScope), one table read by both languages:
Browse normalizes a scope before it asks browse_list_visible, and search_properties holds its scope arguments in
the same form (api/filter_args.py SetScope), so both select the same properties. 'out' empties both lists; an
element on the in side supersedes 'in'; an element sits on one list only (out wins); lists are deduplicated.
An all-empty scope is off (TS null), pinned in setScope.test.ts alone.
